notes.title: A Really Big Mecha Boss
notes.content:
[p]Say hi to the Mecha Boss! A formidable foe you will face while playing MotorSlice!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048810/97cc45fc1797c3ad5fbc390eedf66bd38c8d449d.gif"][/img]
[/p][p]Check the trailer premiered at the Mix Summer Game Showcase 2025, where I share a sneak peek of P climbing and slicing down this massive opponent!

[/p][previewyoutube="6gytRK8SJMM;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
If you haven't yet, check my Youtube Channel! I drop some peak game update from time to time in there!

-

Also, this sounds like a good opportunity to say that MotorSlice will not have a demo on the upcoming Steam Next Fest. I decided to hold back the demo to have a more polished game experience. Trust me, It will be worth it![/p][p][/p][p]Until next game, hopefully with exciting news![/p]

notes.title: New BIG boss announcement trailer on June 3rd!!!
notes.content:
YO! Something super cool is coming up soon! On [b]June 3rd, at 9am US Pacific Time[/b], [b]MOTORSLICE [/b]will debut a new trailer at [b]The MIX Summer Game Showcase[/b] that will reveal... a new EPIC BOSS!!

Don't miss it. This one is definitely BIG. We have been really hard at work on it, and you'll have a great time confronting this boss in the game. Come and take your first look at this massive opponent.

You'll be able to tune in and see the trailer at these links, as well as other mirrors that'll be around online:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/c/MediaIndieExchange]YouTube[/url]
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/mediaindieexchange]Twitch[/url]

See you there... and enjoy!

notes.title: MOTORSLICE - Trailer 2
notes.content:
TRAILER 2 JUST DROPPED!!!

[previewyoutube=W2_T0t2JFFk;full][/previewyoutube]

MotorSlice got funded and will be published by Top Hat Studio. This means we can bring our full vision to the game!

This trailer was part of Top Hat Showcase, which also featured a bunch of other cool games, check it out:


[previewyoutube=5k-5TiW52wg;full][/previewyoutube]

-

A lot happened since I posted here on Steam. The game went viral, we reached not only one - but TWO major milestones and we created a Discord Server for the game! Click the Discord icon below to JOIN NOW!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048810/b40897743e6010764202d27a5206803c32a8136f.gif[/img]

This is only possible because of all of you, so THANK YOU SO MUCH for your support!!!

Stay tuned! Things are going to get serious from now on!

notes.title: GLORIOUS 4K GAMEPLAY
notes.content:
The atmosphere and vibes is a huge part of MotorSlice, so I released a uncut 4k gameplay for the first time!

And I must tell you, it's gorgeous!

[b]WATCH NOW[/b]

[previewyoutube=OrFhhGW5ja8;full][/previewyoutube]

Some of you have been wondering about the image quality since the reveal... Fair enough, compression can destroy all the subtle colors in the game, so I recommend watching this video to put at ease this concern.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048810/47c57ff42b8fb9c0008019461956738901704676.gif[/img]

This gameplay video was featured in the LATAM Game showcase - TGA 2024 Edition, along with a bunch other cool games, go check it out:

[previewyoutube=LRBFWAOPE5k;full][/previewyoutube]

Have a nice week!

notes.title: ONE MONTH SINCE THE ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
Phew... What a month! The reception has been overwhelmingly positive, it doesn't seem real!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048810/6fa952e213ba2ed699cbde72169b1229fdd57dd9.gif[/img]

And we just hit 2k followers on Twitter/X in just a month! Seriously, you guys are the best!

I promise, I only share cool stuff, like this one [url=https://x.com/RegularStudio_/status/1807811734582841409]showing P falling to her death[/url], or [url=https://x.com/RegularStudio_/status/1809260994880843884]this one showing a cool parkour gameplay sequence[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048810/ee96b79983fff6d3538d45be892d308cd217efc7.gif[/img]

Go follow MotorSlice on Twitter for extended gameplay, funny clips and behind the scene stuff. AND more importantly, to be the first one [i]to know when we announce our demo![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048810/d73deca68f759a371a40d295a874dde0c826a3a0.gif[/img]

We also announced that the game's OST is being created by [i]Pizza Hotline[/i]. [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PrGKSRX7ijk]Go check out the Brutal Rush track[/url] for some Atmospheric DnB/Jungle bangers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048810/0c9f8bde8e503ab767a32fddc691af6c655fbf4e.gif[/img]

But this is just the beginning! Follow us and STAY TUNNED
